post.summary: Validate an ACH account.
post.description:
Validates the provided ACH account details including account number, transit number, and
account holder information. Performs business rule validation, merchant context checks, and
may invoke external validation services depending on merchant configuration. Supports name
validation and OFAC validation when enabled for the merchant.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ACH account details to validate. Must not be null.

get.summary: Get an ACH authorization form by ID.
get.description:
Retrieves an auth form directly by its primary key. Returns HTTP 404 if not found, or
HTTP 403 if the user does not have access to the form's merchant. Supports PDF (default)
or JSON output.

parameters.name: auth_form_id
parameters.description: The ACH_Auth_Form_Key of the auth form to retrieve.

parameters.name: pdf
parameters.description:
When true (default), returns the auth form as a downloadable PDF;
            when false, returns an AchAuthFormResponse JSON object.

put.summary: Update associations for an ACH authorization form.
put.description:
Replaces the transaction and/or contract associations for an existing auth form. If
TransactionIds is provided, clears all existing transaction links and sets the new ones.
If ContractIds is provided, clears all existing contract links and sets the new ones. Both
can be updated in a single request. Null lists are skipped.

parameters.name: auth_form_id
parameters.description: The ACH_Auth_Form_Key of the auth form to update.

parameters.name: update_auth_request
parameters.description:
The update request containing optional TransactionIds
            (list of TRX_HD_Key values) and optional ContractIds (list of
            Contract_Key values). Null lists are skipped; non-null lists fully replace existing
            associations.

patch.summary: Update the deferral date on an ACH authorization form.
patch.description:
Appends a deferment notice paragraph to the auth form's HTML content indicating the
payment has been deferred from the original date to the new deferral date. Both dates must
be in MM/dd/yyyy format. Returns HTTP 400 if dates are invalid, HTTP 404 if the auth form
is not found, or HTTP 500 on unexpected error.

parameters.name: auth_form_id
parameters.description: The ACH_Auth_Form_Key of the auth form to update.

parameters.name: ach_auth_form_deferral_date_request
parameters.description:
The deferral update request containing required
            OriginalDate and DeferralDate strings in MM/dd/yyyy format.

get.summary: Get an ACH authorization form by transaction or contract.
get.description:
Retrieves the auth form linked to the specified transaction or contract. Exactly one of
transaction_id or contract_id must be provided. Returns HTTP 400 if neither or both are
specified. Supports PDF (default) or JSON output.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description:
Optional transaction ID (TRX_HD_Key) to look up the auth
            form by transaction association.

parameters.name: contract_id
parameters.description:
Optional contract ID (Contract_Key) to look up the auth form
            by contract association.

parameters.name: pdf
parameters.description:
When true (default), returns the auth form as a downloadable PDF;
            when false, returns an AchAuthFormResponse JSON object.

post.summary: Create a new ACH authorization form.
post.description:
Creates an auth form record with sanitized HTML content. Optionally links to a single
transaction or contract at creation time. Returns HTTP 400 if both transaction_id and
contract_id are provided. If neither is provided, creates a standalone form.

parameters.name: auth_request
parameters.description:
The creation request containing required Html content
            (sanitized), optional TransactionId, and optional ContractId (only one may be
            non-zero).

post.summary: Link a transaction to an existing ACH authorization form.
post.description:
Adds a single transaction to the auth form without clearing existing associations. Returns
HTTP 404 if the auth form is not found. Returns the updated form with refreshed transaction
and contract IDs.

parameters.name: auth_form_id
parameters.description: The ACH_Auth_Form_Key of the auth form to link to.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description:
The TRX_HD_Key of the transaction to add to the auth
            form.

post.summary: Query ACH batches.
post.description:
Returns ACH batches for the current user filtered by the provided query parameters.
Defaults the date range if not provided. Enforces data retention policy. Supports CSV,
PDF, or JSON output formats with pagination.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The batch query parameters.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The output format: "csv", "pdf", or null for JSON.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (optional).

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of records to skip (for paging).

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Number of records to take (for paging).

get.summary: Export ACH transactions via query string parameters.
get.description:
Queries ACH transactions for export via GET with query string parameters. If
ModelState is invalid, returns an empty result set (HTTP 200 with zero
RecordCount) rather than an error. Converts StartDate and EndDate to
UTC before querying. Validates the date range against the data retention policy via
DataRetentionPolicyHelper.ValidateDataRetentionPolicy using
ISsmFeatureFlagHelper.DataRetentionPolicyMaxTimeInYears and
AchTransactionReportMaxRangeInDays; returns HTTP 400 if violated. Delegates to
ICheckReportingQueries.QueryCheckTransactions which supports filtering by
TransactionId, OriginalTransactionId, BatchId (single-record
shortcuts), or full query parameters (date range, merchant, customer, invoice, account
number, transit number, check number, name on check, transaction type, status, processor,
custom fields, and filter param). When the result set exceeds the
ReportResultLimit, the query layer loads records in chunks to avoid memory pressure.
Delegates final formatting to {M:RepayGatewayApi.Web.Controllers.AchReportingController.BuildResponse(System.String,System.String,RepayGatewayApi.Models.Response.CheckReportResponse,RepayGatewayApi.Web.Helpers.HeaderLetterCasing)}.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
Optional output format: "csv", "excel", "pdf",
            or null for JSON.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version string for HATEOAS link generation.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Optional number of records to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: query.start_date
parameters.description: Gets or sets the start date for the ACH transaction query. Required unless transaction, original transaction, or batch ID is provided.

parameters.name: query.end_date
parameters.description: Gets or sets the end date for the ACH transaction query. Required unless transaction, original transaction, or batch ID is provided.

parameters.name: query.name_on_check
parameters.description: Gets or sets the name on the check for the transaction.

parameters.name: query.check_number

parameters.name: query.transit_number

parameters.name: query.account_number

parameters.name: query.original_transaction_id
parameters.description: Gets or sets the original transaction identifier, if applicable.

parameters.name: query.batch_id
parameters.description: Gets or sets the batch identifier, if applicable.

parameters.name: query.trx_status
parameters.description: Gets or sets the transaction status.

parameters.name: query.processor_id
parameters.description: Gets or sets the processor identifier for the transaction.

parameters.name: query.custom_fields

parameters.name: query.merchant_name

parameters.name: query.merchant_id
parameters.description: Gets or sets the merchant ID.

parameters.name: query.username

parameters.name: query.transaction_id

parameters.name: query.exclude_voids
parameters.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to exclude voided transactions.

parameters.name: query.trx_type
parameters.description: Gets or sets the transaction type.

parameters.name: query.result
parameters.description: Gets or sets the result filter for the transaction query.

parameters.name: query.exclude_result
parameters.description: Gets or sets the result to exclude from the transaction query.

parameters.name: query.total_amount
parameters.description: Gets or sets the total amount as a string.

parameters.name: query.customer_id
parameters.description: Gets or sets the customer ID.

parameters.name: query.register
parameters.description: Gets or sets the register identifier.

parameters.name: query.invoice_number

parameters.name: query.approval_code

parameters.name: query.filter_param

get.summary: Get ACH transactions.
get.description:
Retrieves recent ACH transactions for the authenticated user. If {transactionId}
is provided and valid, calls ICheckReportingQueries.GetTransactionsByAccount which
decrypts the specified transaction's bank account and routing numbers, then queries all
transactions matching those account details (paginated via {take} and
{skip}). If {transactionId} is null or zero, calls
GetTransactions which returns the most recent transactions for the user (limited by
{take} or the environment's ReportResultLimit). In both cases,
filters results through IDataRetentionPolicyValidator.IsValidTransaction(t.Date) to
exclude transactions outside the data retention window. Returns HTTP 400 with
ErrorMessages.InvalidTransId if {transactionId} is non-null but
cannot be parsed as an integer. Delegates final formatting to
{M:RepayGatewayApi.Web.Controllers.AchReportingController.BuildResponse(System.String,System.String,RepayGatewayApi.Models.Response.CheckReportResponse,RepayGatewayApi.Web.Helpers.HeaderLetterCasing)}.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description:
Optional transaction ID string. When provided (non-null),
            retrieves related transactions on the same bank account. Must be parsable as an
            integer.

parameters.name: filter_by
parameters.description:
Optional filter string applied to narrow results (e.g., by
            transaction type or status).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
Optional output format: "csv", "excel", "pdf",
            or null for JSON.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description:
API version string, passed to ILinkHelper.CreateLinks for
            HATEOAS link generation in JSON responses.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Optional number of records to skip for pagination.

get.summary: Get NACHA return rate threshold compliance report.
get.description:
Generates a NACHA return rate threshold compliance report. For reseller users, queries across
all merchants (passes null for merchant IDs); for merchant users, scopes to
IRequestInfo.UserMerchantIds. Defaults startDate to 60 days ago and
endDate to now if not specified. Validates the date range against the data retention
policy via DataRetentionPolicyHelper.ValidateDataRetentionPolicy; returns HTTP 400 if
violated. Delegates to ICheckReportingQueries.GetNachaThresholdReport which executes a
hand-written SQL query (via AchSql.NachaThresholdReportQuery) with a 60-second timeout,
producing a NachaThresholdReport containing per-merchant return rate data:
Unauthorized, Administrative, and Overall return rates/counts with
MerchantId, MerchantName, and Originations count. When
{noZeroTrx} is true, excludes merchants with zero originations. For
"csv" format, maps NachaThresholdMerchantValues to
NachaThresholdReportFlattened via AutoMapper and outputs via
IResponseHelper.GenerateCsvReportFromProperties (property-based CSV with
Content-Disposition: attachment, filename "export.csv"). For JSON (default),
returns the full NachaThresholdReport object.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description:
Optional start date for the report period. Defaults to 60 days
            ago.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Optional end date for the report period. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
Optional output format: "csv" for CSV download, or null
            for JSON.

parameters.name: no_zero_trx
parameters.description:
When true, excludes merchants with zero originations from
            the report. Defaults to false.

post.summary: Query ACH transactions with full filter capabilities.
post.description:
Queries ACH transactions via POST with the query in the request body. Functionally identical
to {M:RepayGatewayApi.Web.Controllers.AchReportingController.QueryExportTransactions(RepayGatewayApi.Models.Request.AchTransactionQuery,System.String,System.String,System.Nullable{System.Int32},System.Nullable{System.Int32})} but accepts the AchTransactionQuery as a
JSON request body instead of query string parameters. Additionally logs the query parameters
at informational level via _logger.Information including take, skip,
and the full query object. For CSV and Excel output formats, uses snake_case column headers
via PickHeaderLetterCasing (returns HeaderLetterCasing.SnakeCase for
"csv" and "excel" formats, HeaderLetterCasing.Default otherwise).
If ModelState is invalid, returns an empty result set. Validates the date range
against the data retention policy; returns HTTP 400 if violated. Delegates final formatting
to {M:RepayGatewayApi.Web.Controllers.AchReportingController.BuildResponse(System.String,System.String,RepayGatewayApi.Models.Response.CheckReportResponse,RepayGatewayApi.Web.Helpers.HeaderLetterCasing)}.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The ACH transaction query from the request body.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
Optional output format: "csv", "excel", "pdf",
            or null for JSON. CSV/Excel formats use snake_case column headers.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version string for HATEOAS link generation.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Optional number of records to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of records to return.

get.description: Retrieves all ACH tokens associated with a specific customer.

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The customer key whose ACH tokens to retrieve. Must be non-zero.

post.description:
Creates a new ACH token for a specific customer, storing the bank account information as a tokenized payment method.
Validates that external payment tokens are allowed for the merchant if provided.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ACH token creation request containing bank account details.

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The customer key to associate the token with. Must be non-zero.

get.description: Retrieves a specific ACH token by token key without requiring a customer key, optionally including the decline count.

put.summary: Update an ACH token by token key.

post.summary: Create an ACH token for the current merchant.
post.description:
Creates a new ACH token for the current merchant without associating it to a specific customer.
Validates that external payment tokens are allowed for the merchant if provided.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ACH token creation request containing bank account details.

post.summary: Query ACH tokens.
post.description:
Queries ACH tokens by token IDs, customer IDs, or account numbers. Filters results to merchants the current user can access.
Returns a paginated list of matching ACH tokens.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The query parameters including optional token IDs, customer IDs, and account numbers.

post.summary:
Processes an ACH sale (debit) transaction, debiting funds from the customer's bank account.
Routes to either the Repay ACH backend or the legacy check processor based on merchant configuration.
Defaults the entry description to "PURCHASE" if not provided.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ACH sale request containing account, amount, and transaction details.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (optional).

post.summary:
Processes an ACH credit (disbursement) transaction, sending funds to the customer's bank account.
Only supported for merchants on the Repay ACH backend; legacy processor merchants should use the SOAP API Transact endpoint.
Defaults the entry description to "DISBURSE" if not provided.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ACH credit request containing account, amount, and transaction details.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (optional).

post.summary: Performs a bulk void of ACH transactions. Restricted to reseller users.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The bulk void request containing the transaction IDs to void.

post.summary:
Processes an ACH debit prenote transaction, which is a zero-dollar test debit used to verify a bank account
before initiating live debits. Only supported for merchants on the Repay ACH backend.
Defaults the entry description to "PURCHASE" if not provided.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ACH debit prenote request containing account and routing details.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (optional).

post.summary:
Processes an ACH credit prenote transaction, which is a zero-dollar test credit used to verify a bank account
before initiating live credits/disbursements. Only supported for merchants on the Repay ACH backend.
Defaults the entry description to "DISBURSE" if not provided.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ACH credit prenote request containing account and routing details.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (optional).

post.summary:
Voids a previously created ACH transaction, cancelling it before settlement.
Routes to either the Repay ACH backend or the legacy check processor based on merchant configuration.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the transaction to void. Must be a valid numeric value.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (optional).

post.summary:
Processes an offset transaction against a previously settled ACH credit, debiting back the credited amount
(fully or partially). The original transaction must be settled and must be a credit transaction.
The offset amount cannot exceed the original credit amount minus any previous offsets.
If the amount is zero, the remaining unoffsetted balance is debited.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the original settled credit transaction to offset.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The offset request containing the amount, convenience amount, and invoice ID.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (optional).

post.summary:
Processes a rebill (repeat sale) for a previous ACH transaction, creating a new debit based on the original transaction details.
Validates the transaction against the data retention policy before processing.
Routes to either the Repay ACH backend or the legacy check processor based on merchant configuration.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the original transaction to rebill.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The rebill request containing optional override values such as amount and check number.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (optional).

post.summary:
Processes a refund (credit) for a previous ACH transaction, returning funds to the customer's bank account.
Routes to either the Repay ACH backend or the legacy check processor based on merchant configuration.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the original transaction to refund.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The refund request containing optional override values such as amount.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version (optional).

post.summary:
Sends a transaction receipt email for a specific ACH transaction to the specified email address.
Validates that the user has access to the transaction's merchant before sending.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the ACH transaction.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The email receipt request containing the recipient email address.

get.summary: Get bank information by routing number.
get.description:
Retrieves bank information for the specified ACH routing number from the FedACH directory.
The routing number is validated via the {RepayGatewayApi.Models.ValidationAttributes.RoutingNumberAttribute} (must be a valid
9-digit ABA routing number passing the checksum algorithm). Returns a RoutingBankInformation
response containing the bank name (from CustomerName), full address (street, city, state, zip,
country code "USA"), formatted telephone number, servicing FRB number, office code, data view code,
record type code, institution status code, new routing number (if reassigned), and change date.

parameters.name: routing_number
parameters.description: The 9-digit ABA routing number to look up. Validated by {RepayGatewayApi.Models.ValidationAttributes.RoutingNumberAttribute}.

post.summary: Validate a card account.
post.description:
Validates a card account by submitting the primary account number and optional cardholder details
to the Visa Payment Account Validation service. Returns card validity status, BIN data
(issuing bank, country, brand, category, type), and optional name verification results.
<para>
The response includes a result code: "0" indicates a valid account (Visa action code "00"),
"12" indicates an invalid account or service unavailability. If the Visa service returns an error,
the result text will indicate that account validation is currently unavailable.
</para><para>
Name validation is performed when the merchant has card account name validation enabled
and at least the last_name field is provided in the request. Decision codes are mapped as:
"01" = Match, "50" = Partial Match, "99" = No Match. If name validation is enabled but
last name is not provided, the response will include an instructional message.
</para>

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The card account validation request containing the primary account number,
            optional expiration date, CVV, and account holder details (name, address, email, phone).

application/json.nameValidationPerformedText: Name Validation was performed, and is a billable event.

get.summary: Get card information by BIN/IIN number.
get.description:
Retrieves card issuer information for the specified BIN/IIN number. Calls
IBinDataService.GetBinData with the BIN and the authenticated merchant's ID (or 0 if not
available), which queries the external BIN data provider and applies any merchant-specific or global
BIN override rules. The IinRange result is mapped to a CardInfoResponse containing
country, bank name, brand, category, type, commercial card flag, and brand-specific product indicators
(e.g., CommercialCardLevel2DataIndicator, CommercialCardLevel3DataIndicator, LargeTicketIndicator,
ProductId for Visa cards).

parameters.name: bin_number
parameters.description:
The BIN/IIN number to look up (up to 11 digits, validated by {System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.StringLengthAttribute}).
            Can be a full or partial card number; only the leading digits are used for the BIN lookup.

post.summary: Queue a card settlement batch for closing.
post.description: Queues a card settlement batch for closing. Supports two modes depending on the request: By batch ID — when request.BatchId is provided, calls QueueClosingBatchByBatchIdAsync which validates the batch ID range, fetches the batch, verifies the batch belongs to the authenticated merchant, validates the batch status is "Open" via FluentValidation, updates the status to "Queued", and raises a batch closing event.Single batch — when request.BatchId is null, calls QueueClosingSingleBatchAsync which validates the merchant's feature flag enablement, resolves the single processor profile for the merchant, fetches the single open batch for that processor profile, validates and queues it for closing. On success, returns HTTP 202 Accepted with a {RepayGatewayApi.Models.Response.CloseCardSettlementBatchResponse} containing the batch ID and a correlation ID (from the CloudFront request header). On validation failure, the FluentValidation.Results.ValidationResult errors are added to the ModelState and a non-success response is returned.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The batch closing request. If BatchId is set, that specific batch is
            queued; if null, the single open batch for the merchant is automatically selected. The BatchId
            must be within the valid SequenceRange for card batch keys if provided.

get.summary: Get all card tokens for a customer.
get.description:
Retrieves all card tokens for a given customer. Verifies the caller has access to the merchant
that owns the customer record. Returns a list of card token details.

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The customer key whose card tokens to retrieve. Must be non-zero.

post.summary: Create a card token for a customer.
post.description:
Creates a new card token for a specific customer. Stores the card's PAN (encrypted), expiration date,
name on card, address, and nickname. Performs BIN data lookup to determine card brand and type,
checks network tokenization eligibility via CyberSource, and creates a network token if eligible.
Emits a StoreCardEvent gateway event. Verifies the caller has access to the owning merchant.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The create request containing card number, expiration date, name on card, address, and nickname.

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The customer key to associate the card token with. Must be non-zero.

get.summary: Get a card token by token key.
get.description:
Retrieves a card token by card token key without requiring a customer key. Verifies the caller
has access to the merchant that owns the card token. The card token must belong to the
authenticated merchant directly (not via customer association).

parameters.name: card_token_key
parameters.description: The card token key to retrieve. Must be non-zero.

parameters.name: include_decline_count
parameters.description: When true, includes the decline count for the card token. Defaults to false.

put.summary: Update a card token by token key.
put.description:
Fully updates a card token without requiring a customer key. Replaces all mutable fields with the
provided values. Performs BIN data lookup, PAN encryption, and network tokenization eligibility check.
Emits an UpdateCardEvent gateway event. The card token must belong to the authenticated merchant.

parameters.name: card_token_key
parameters.description: The card token key to update. Must be non-zero.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The update request containing card number, expiration date, name, address, and nickname.

delete.summary: Delete a card token by token key.
delete.description:
Deletes a card token without requiring a customer key. Soft-deletes the card token record.
The card token must belong to the authenticated merchant.

parameters.name: card_token_key
parameters.description: The card token key to delete. Must be non-zero.

patch.summary: Partially update a card token by token key.
patch.description:
Partially updates a card token without requiring a customer key. Only the supplied (non-null) fields
overwrite the corresponding fields; unset fields retain their current values.
The card token must belong to the authenticated merchant.

parameters.name: card_token_key
parameters.description: The card token key to patch. Must be non-zero.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The partial update request containing only the fields to change.

get.summary: Get a card token for a customer.
get.description:
Retrieves a card token by customer key and card token key. Verifies the caller has access to the
merchant that owns the card token. Returns card token details including last 4 digits, BIN,
expiration date, card type/brand, name on card, address fields, nickname, customer ID,
and optionally network tokenized card details. If the token is not found or the customer key
doesn't match, throws ItemNotFoundException.

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The customer key that owns the card token. Must be non-zero.

parameters.name: card_token_key

put.summary: Update a card token for a customer.

expiration date, name on card, address, nickname) with the provided values. Performs BIN data
lookup, PAN encryption, and network tokenization eligibility check. Emits an UpdateCardEvent
gateway event. Verifies the caller has access to the owning merchant.

parameters.name: card_token_key

Verifies the caller has access to the owning merchant.

parameters.description: The customer key that owns the card token. Must be non-zero.

overwrite the corresponding fields on the existing token; unset fields retain their current values.

get.summary: Get network tokenization events for a customer's card tokens.
get.description:
Retrieves network tokenization events for a customer's card tokens within an optional date range.
Returns up to 1000 events per page with cursor-based pagination. Events are sourced from the
network tokenization events engine. Date ranges are validated against the data retention policy
(maximum years back and maximum range in days, configured via SSM feature flags).

post.summary: Create a card token for the current merchant.

Creates a new card token without customer association. Stores the card's PAN (encrypted), expiration date,
name on card, address, and nickname. Performs BIN data lookup to determine card brand and type,
checks network tokenization eligibility, and creates a network token if eligible.

multiple merchants the caller has access to), and other criteria defined in CardTokenQueryRequest.
Merchants the caller cannot access are excluded from the results. Returns a CardTokenQueryResponse
containing matching card tokens.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The query request containing filter criteria such as customer IDs.

get.summary: Get a card transaction by ID.

transaction does not belong to the authenticated user's merchant. Validates the transaction
date against the data retention policy.

Used by the UI to warn users that a rebill may use a different processor profile than the
original transaction. Returns ShowWarning = true with the original profile description if
profiles differ. Returns HTTP 404 if the transaction is not found. Gracefully handles errors
by returning ShowWarning = false.

post.summary: Authorize a card transaction.
post.description:
Processes a card authorization that reserves funds without capturing them. Supports 3-D Secure
authentication data. Reseller users must provide the MerchantId header. Supports auto-reversal
retry for debit cards. Returns HTTP 200 if approved or HTTP 201 otherwise.

The card auth request containing card number, amount, and optional

parameters.name: version

Processes a combined authorization and capture in a single step. Supports 3-D Secure
authentication data. Reseller users must provide the MerchantId header. Supports auto-reversal

post.summary: Force capture a card transaction with an approval code.

individually and returns a result indicating full success or partial failure with details of

The bulk void request containing a list of

post.description:
Pushes funds to a cardholder's card. Requires the MerchantId header. Returns HTTP 200 if
approved or HTTP 201 otherwise.

parameters.name: request

The disbursement request with card number, amount, and recipient

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version for HATEOAS links.

containing transaction IDs and processes each reversal individually. Returns a result
containing successful and failed transactions. Returns HTTP 415 if the content is not

parameters.name: version

get.summary: Get a cash transaction by ID.
get.description:
Retrieves a single cash transaction by ID. Validates that the transaction belongs to the authenticated
user's merchant before returning. Marked as a reporting action.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The API version string used for constructing HATEOAS links.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the cash transaction to retrieve.

post.summary: Process a cash sale transaction.
post.description:
Processes a cash sale transaction. Maps the request to a CashSale model and delegates to
ICashTransactionEngine.ProcessSale, which validates the merchant has a cash profile,
creates TRX_Cash_T, TRX_Header_T, and TRX_Invoice_T records, and populates
merchant ID, reseller key, user key, and username from the request context. Also supports eCash
transactions when the sale includes eCash-specific custom fields. Emits a CashSaleEvent
gateway event. Requires the merchant ID header for reseller users.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The cash sale request containing amount, invoice ID, customer ID, register number, convenience amount, and optional custom fields.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The API version string used for constructing HATEOAS links.

post.summary: Void a cash transaction.
post.description:
Voids a cash transaction by ID. Validates that the authenticated user has access to the transaction,
then delegates to ICashTransactionEngine.ProcessVoid, which verifies the original transaction
exists, has not already been voided, is not settled, and has not been refunded. Creates a new void
transaction record (cloned from the original with Trans_Type_ID = Void), flags the original
as voided and reversed, and saves both. Emits a CashVoidEvent gateway event. Requires the
merchant ID header for reseller users.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the cash transaction to void.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The API version string used for constructing HATEOAS links.

post.summary: Refund a cash transaction.
post.description:
Refunds a cash transaction by ID with an optional amount. Validates that the authenticated user has
access to the transaction, then delegates to ICashTransactionEngine.ProcessRefund, which
verifies the original transaction exists, has not been voided, and that the refund amount (if
specified) does not exceed the original amount or the remaining refundable balance (original minus
cumulative prior refunds). Creates a new credit transaction record linked to the original. Emits a
CashReversalEvent gateway event. Requires the merchant ID header for reseller users.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the cash transaction to refund.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The refund request containing the optional refund amount. If null, the full original amount is refunded.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The API version string used for constructing HATEOAS links.

post.summary: Send an email receipt for a cash transaction.
post.description:
Sends an email receipt for a cash transaction. Delegates to
ICashTransactionEngine.EmailTransactionReceipt, which generates and sends a receipt email
to the specified address for the given transaction.

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: The ID of the cash transaction to generate a receipt for.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The email receipt request containing the recipient email address. Must not be null.

post.summary: Query cash transactions.
post.description: Queries cash transactions with filtering, pagination, and multiple output formats. Filters are applied against the TrxDetailCash view scoped to the authenticated user's accessible merchants. Supports filtering by date range, transaction type, amount, customer ID, invoice number, merchant name, username, register number, transaction status, custom fields, and a free-text filter parameter. Results are capped at IEnvironmentValues.ReportResultLimit. Marked as a reporting action. CSV — converts transaction dates to merchant-local time via IDateTimeUtils.ConvertUtcTimeByOffset and generates a CSV file using ReportColumnType.Cash column definitions.PDF — generates a PDF report using ReportColumnType.Cash column definitions with the user's timezone offset for date formatting.JSON (default) — returns a CashTransactionsReportResponse with paginated transactions (including HATEOAS links) and a total record count.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The query filter criteria including start/end dates, transaction type, amount, customer ID, invoice number, merchant name, username, register, status, custom fields, and free-text filter. Must not be null.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The output format: "csv", "pdf", or null/other for JSON. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The API version string used for constructing HATEOAS links in JSON format.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination. Optional.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Number of records to return. Defaults to IEnvironmentValues.ReportResultLimit if not specified; capped at the report result limit.

get.summary: Get all contracts for a customer.
get.description:
Retrieves all recurring billing contracts for the specified customer. Validates customer
ownership, then delegates to IContractEngine.GetCustomerContracts which queries the
ContractInfoes database view for all Contract_T records where
Customer_Key matches {customerKey}, mapped to
ContractInfoResponse via AutoMapper. Each response includes contract details
(Contract_Key, Contract_ID, Contract_Name_VC), billing info
(Bill_Amt, Tax_Amt, Total_Amt, Billing_Period_ID,
Next_Bill_DT), payment method info (Card_Info_Key or Check_Info_Key,
Last4_Num), and status/user info.

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The Customer_Key to retrieve contracts for.

post.summary: Create a recurring billing contract for a customer.
post.description:
Creates a new recurring billing contract for the specified customer. Performs the following
validations before creation:
<list type="number"><item><description>Parses NextBillDateRaw via
ContractRequest.SetParsedNextBillDate: if the raw string has no explicit time
component (determined by IDateTimeUtils.HasExplicitTime) and
IMerchantXmlProfile.DefaultRecurringContractHour is configured, applies the default
hour to the parsed NextBillDate.</description></item><item><description>Validates NextBillDate <= EndDate; returns HTTP 400 ("End date
must be later than the next bill date") if violated.</description></item><item><description>Validates exactly one of CardInfoId or CheckInfoId is
provided (not both, not neither); returns HTTP 400 if violated.</description></item><item><description>Validates customer ownership via
{M:RepayGatewayApi.Web.Controllers.ContractsController.ValidateCustomerOwnership(System.Int32)}.</description></item></list>
Delegates to IContractEngine.AddContract which maps the request to a
Contract_T entity, sets Customer_Key, Card_Info_Key or
Check_Info_Key, and the creating user key, then persists via
IContractService.AddContract. Returns the created ContractResponse (containing
Info and CustomFields).

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The Customer_Key to create the contract for.

parameters.name: contract_request
parameters.description:
The contract creation request. Cannot be null (enforced by
            [ModelCannotBeNull]). Contains billing details (StartDate,
            NextBillDateRaw/NextBillDate, EndDate, BillingPeriod,
            BillingInterval, Subtotal, Tax, NumPayments), payment method
            (CardInfoId or CheckInfoId), and contract metadata (ContractId,
            ContractName, Status, MaxFailures).

get.summary: Get a contract by ID for a customer.
get.description:
Retrieves a single recurring billing contract by its key for the specified customer. Validates
customer ownership, then delegates to IContractEngine.GetCustomerContractById which
also validates ownership of the contract (that Contract_T.Customer_Key matches
{customerKey}) and retrieves the contract with its custom field values via
IContractService.GetCustomerContractById. Returns a ContractResponse containing
Info (ContractInfoResponse with all contract/billing/payment details) and
CustomFields (list of ContractCustomFieldValue entries).

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The Customer_Key that owns the contract.

parameters.name: contract_key
parameters.description: The Contract_Key of the contract to retrieve.

put.summary: Update a recurring billing contract for a customer.
put.description:
Updates an existing recurring billing contract for the specified customer. Performs the same
validations as {M:RepayGatewayApi.Web.Controllers.ContractsController.AddContract(System.Int32,RepayGatewayApi.Models.Request.ContractRequest)}:
<list type="number"><item><description>Parses NextBillDateRaw via
ContractRequest.SetParsedNextBillDate, applying the merchant's
DefaultRecurringContractHour when no explicit time is provided.</description></item><item><description>Validates NextBillDate <= EndDate.</description></item><item><description>Validates exactly one of CardInfoId or CheckInfoId is
provided.</description></item><item><description>Validates customer ownership.</description></item></list>
Delegates to IContractEngine.UpdateContract which loads the existing
Contract_T entity by {contractKey}, updates the fields from the
request, sets the Last_Update_UserKey to the authenticated user's key, and persists
via IContractService.UpdateContract. Returns the updated ContractResponse.

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The Customer_Key that owns the contract.

parameters.name: contract_key
parameters.description: The Contract_Key of the contract to update.

parameters.name: contract_request
parameters.description:
The contract update request. Cannot be null (enforced by
            [ModelCannotBeNull]). Contains the same fields as the creation request.

get.summary: Get all customers for the authenticated merchant.
get.description:
Retrieves all customers for the authenticated user's merchant. Queries Customer_T
records (including Contacts_T and Address_T) filtered by the merchant ID
from the request header, and maps them to a list of CustomerResponse objects.
Requires the merchant ID header.

post.summary: Create a new customer for the authenticated merchant.
post.description:
Creates a new customer for the authenticated user's merchant. Maps the CustomerRequest
to a new Customer_T entity with associated Contacts_T and Address_T
records, sets the merchant key from the request header, defaults the status to Active,
sets Creation_DT to the current time, and saves to the database. Requires the merchant
ID header.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The customer creation request containing customer ID (max 50 chars), customer name, and required contact info with address. Must not be null.

get.summary: Get a customer by key.
get.description:
Retrieves a single customer by key. Looks up the Customer_T record (including
Contacts_T and Address_T) and maps it to a CustomerResponse.
Verifies the authenticated user has access to the customer's owning merchant before returning.

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The customer key (Customer_Key). Must be non-zero (validated by {RepayGatewayApi.Models.ValidationAttributes.NonZeroAttribute}).

put.summary: Fully update a customer by key.
put.description:
Fully updates an existing customer by key. Performs a full replacement of the customer record
via AutoMapper mapping from CustomerRequest to the existing Customer_T entity.
The customer name, customer ID, status (defaulted to Active since Status is
[JsonIgnore] on CustomerRequest), contact (first name, last name, email),
and address fields are all overwritten. Updates Last_Update_DT to the current time.
Verifies the authenticated user has access to the customer's owning merchant before updating.

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The customer key to update. Must be non-zero (validated by {RepayGatewayApi.Models.ValidationAttributes.NonZeroAttribute}).

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The full customer update request containing customer ID, customer name, and required contact info with address. Must not be null.

patch.summary: Partially update a customer by key.
patch.description:
Partially updates an existing customer by key. Only non-null fields in the request are applied
to the existing Customer_T entity via IMergeCustomerEngine.MergeCustomer.
For example, if only CustomerName is provided, only the name is updated; all other
fields retain their current values. Similarly, nested Contact and Address
fields are individually merged only when provided. Updates Last_Update_DT to the
current time. Verifies the authenticated user has access to the customer's owning merchant
before patching.

parameters.name: customer_key
parameters.description: The customer key to patch. Must be non-zero (validated by {RepayGatewayApi.Models.ValidationAttributes.NonZeroAttribute}).

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The partial customer update request. Only non-null fields are applied. Must not be null.

get.summary: Get all custom field definitions for the authenticated merchant.
get.description:
Retrieves all active custom field definitions for the authenticated user's merchant. Reads
fresh from the database (bypassing the per-instance definition cache) so the list reflects
committed DB state. Queries Custom_Fields_T where Merchant_Key equals
IRequestInfo.Merchant.MerchantId and PendingDeletion is false, mapped
to CustomField objects via AutoMapper. Each CustomField includes
CustomFieldId, CustomFieldName, Description, IsRequired,
IsNumeric, DecimalPlaces, MinValue, MaxValue,
MinLength, MaxLength, RegEx, ErrorMessage, and
DisplayOnReceipt.

post.summary: Create a custom field definition for the authenticated merchant.
post.description:
Creates a new custom field definition for the authenticated user's merchant. Delegates to
ICustomFieldsEngine.CreateCustomField which:
<list type="number"><item><description>Validates uniqueness of CustomFieldName within the merchant by
querying Custom_Fields_T for an existing record with the same
Custom_Field_Name and Merchant_Key. Throws
DuplicateItemFoundException if found (message includes the conflicting field's
Custom_Field_Key).</description></item><item><description>Maps the {request} to a Custom_Fields_T entity
via AutoMapper, sets Merchant_Key to the authenticated user's merchant ID, adds to
the Custom_Fields_T DbSet, and calls SaveChanges.</description></item><item><description>Returns the created entity mapped to a CustomFieldResponse via
AutoMapper (containing the generated CustomFieldId and all field
properties).</description></item></list>

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The custom field creation request. Cannot be null (enforced by
            [ModelCannotBeNull]). Contains CustomFieldName (max 50 chars, validated by
            [CustomFieldName]), required Description (max 50 chars), IsRequired,
            IsNumeric, DecimalPlaces, MinValue, MaxValue,
            MinLength, MaxLength, RegEx, ErrorMessage, and
            DisplayOnReceipt.

get.summary: Get custom field values for a transaction.
get.description:
Retrieves custom field values for a specific transaction. Returns HTTP 400 with
ErrorMessages.InvalidTransId if {transactionId} is zero. Queries the
Custom_Field_Values_V view via
ICustomFieldQueries.GetCustomFieldsByMerchantAndTransaction using the authenticated
user's UserKey (which resolves the user's accessible merchant IDs via
IUserDataService.GetUserMerchants to filter values to only merchants the user can
access). When {displayOnReceipt} is specified, further filters by
DisplayOnVTReceipt matching the provided value. Results are projected to
CustomFieldValue objects (containing CustomFieldId, CustomFieldName,
Description, MerchantId, FieldValue, TransactionId, and
DisplayOnReceipt).

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description:
The TRX_HD_Key of the transaction to retrieve custom
            field values for. Must be non-zero.

parameters.name: display_on_receipt
parameters.description:
Optional filter. When true, returns only custom field
            values where DisplayOnVTReceipt is true. When false, returns only values where
            it is false. When null (default), returns all custom field values.

put.description:
Updates an existing custom field definition for the authenticated user's merchant. Delegates
to ICustomFieldsEngine.UpdateCustomField which:
<list type="number"><item><description>Looks up the Custom_Fields_T record by
{customFieldId} and Merchant_Key, excluding records where
PendingDeletion is true. Throws ItemNotFoundException if not
found.</description></item><item><description>Validates CustomFieldName uniqueness against other fields
for the same merchant (excluding the current field by Custom_Field_Key != customFieldId).
Throws DuplicateItemFoundException if another field with the same name
exists.</description></item><item><description>Maps the {customFieldRequest} onto the existing
Custom_Fields_T entity via AutoMapper, marks it as modified, and calls
SaveChanges.</description></item><item><description>Returns the updated entity mapped to a CustomFieldResponse via
AutoMapper.</description></item></list>

parameters.name: custom_field_request
parameters.description:
The custom field update request. Cannot be null (enforced
            by [ModelCannotBeNull]). Contains the same fields as the creation
            request.

parameters.name: custom_field_id
parameters.description:
The Custom_Field_Key of the custom field to
            update.

get.summary: Get digital wallet merchant details.
get.description:
Retrieves digital wallet merchant details by wallet merchant ID. Restricted to reseller users;
returns HTTP 403 for non-reseller users. Maps the {RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletUriRequest} to a
Merchant model (with correlation ID) and delegates to
IMerchantRegistration.GetMerchantAsync. The result is mapped to a
{RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletMerchantDetailsResponse} containing the wallet merchant ID and
Services (ApplePay enabled flag, domain names). After retrieval, checks if the merchant
was not found (ApplePay not enabled and no domain names configured), throwing
ItemNotFoundException in that case.

parameters.name: request.wallet_merchant_id
parameters.description: Gets or sets the digital wallet merchant identifier.

parameters.name: request.use_test_keys
parameters.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to use test keys for the digital wallet URI request.

delete.description:
Deletes a digital wallet merchant by wallet merchant ID. Restricted to reseller users;
returns HTTP 403 for non-reseller users. Maps the {RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletUriRequest} to a
Merchant model (with correlation ID) and delegates to
IMerchantRegistration.DeleteMerchantAsync. Throws BadRequestException for
InvalidRequestException errors and InternalServerErrorException for unexpected
errors.

parameters.name: request.wallet_merchant_id
parameters.description: Gets or sets the digital wallet merchant identifier.

parameters.name: request.use_test_keys
parameters.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to use test keys for the digital wallet URI request.

post.summary: Update a digital wallet merchant's configuration.
post.description:
Updates an existing digital wallet merchant's configuration. Maps the
{RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletMerchantRequest} (containing the wallet merchant ID and
Services data) to a MerchantServices model and delegates to
IMerchantRegistration.UpdateMerchantAsync. The result is mapped back to a
{RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletMerchantDetailsResponse}. Reseller authorization is temporarily
disabled per RG-9167 (TODO: revert in the future). Throws BadRequestException for
InvalidRequestException errors and InternalServerErrorException for unexpected
errors.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The merchant update request containing the wallet merchant ID and
            required Services configuration. Must not be null.

post.summary: Register a new digital wallet merchant.
post.description:
Registers a new digital wallet merchant. Maps the {RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletMerchantRequest}
(containing the wallet merchant ID and Services data) to a MerchantServices
model and delegates to IMerchantRegistration.RegisterMerchantAsync. The result is
mapped back to a {RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletMerchantDetailsResponse}. Reseller authorization
is temporarily disabled per RG-9167 (TODO: revert in the future). Throws
BadRequestException for InvalidRequestException errors and
InternalServerErrorException for unexpected errors.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The merchant registration request containing the wallet merchant ID and
            required Services configuration. Must not be null.

post.summary: Create an Apple Pay web session.
post.description:
Creates an Apple Pay web session for use in Apple Pay JS on the web. Maps the
{RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletWebSessionRequest} (containing the wallet merchant ID, domain name,
and display name) to a WebSessionRequest and delegates to
IApplePayWebSession.GetWebSessionAsync. The response is mapped back to a
{RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletWebSessionResponse}. Throws BadRequestException for invalid
requests (e.g., invalid domain) and InternalServerErrorException for unexpected errors.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The Apple Pay web session request containing the wallet merchant ID
            (validated by DigitalWalletMerchantIdValidation), a valid domain name, and a display
            name. Must not be null.

post.summary: Authorize a card transaction via Apple Pay.
post.description:
Processes an Apple Pay card authorization. Decrypts the Apple Pay payment token via
IDigitalWalletClient.ProcessApplePayLoadAsync (which calls
IApplePayCryptography.DecryptApplePayAsync), then maps the decrypted DPAN, expiry,
and cryptogram to a CardAuthRequest. Routes to ICardProcessingEngine.ProcessAuthAsync
(new engine, mapping to CardAuth) or ICardTransactionEngine.ProcessAuth (legacy
engine, mapping to CardAuthOld) based on the NewCardEngineEnabledForMerchantIds
SSM feature flag. Uses CardAuthMethod.APAY_DW as the authentication method. Results
are mapped to {RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletTransactionDetailCard}. Emits CardAuthEvent and
CardTransaction gateway events. Reseller users must provide the MerchantId header.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The Apple Pay digital wallet request containing the encrypted payment token,
            wallet merchant ID, amount, invoice ID, surcharge, convenience amount, and custom fields. Must not be null.

post.summary: Process a card sale via Apple Pay.
post.description:
Processes an Apple Pay card sale (combined authorization and capture). Decrypts the Apple Pay
payment token via IDigitalWalletClient.ProcessApplePayLoadAsync (which calls
IApplePayCryptography.DecryptApplePayAsync), then maps the decrypted DPAN, expiry, and
cryptogram to a CardSaleRequest. Routes to ICardProcessingEngine.ProcessAuthAsync
(new engine, mapping to CardSale) or ICardTransactionEngine.ProcessAuth with
CardTransactionType.Sale (legacy engine, mapping to CardAuthOld) based on the
NewCardEngineEnabledForMerchantIds SSM feature flag. Uses CardAuthMethod.APAY_DW
as the authentication method. Results are mapped to {RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletTransactionDetailCard}.
The transaction is immediately captured for settlement. Emits CardSaleEvent and
CardTransaction gateway events. Reseller users must provide the MerchantId header.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The Apple Pay digital wallet request containing the encrypted payment token,
            wallet merchant ID, amount, invoice ID, surcharge, convenience amount, and custom fields. Must not be null.

post.summary: Authorize a card transaction via Google Pay.
post.description:
Processes a Google Pay card authorization. Decrypts the Google Pay payment token via
IDigitalWalletClient.ProcessGooglePayLoadAsync (which calls
IGooglePayCryptography.DecryptGooglePayAsync), then maps the decrypted DPAN, expiry,
cryptogram, and authentication type to a CardAuthRequest. The authentication method is
determined by the AuthenticationType from the decrypted response:
CardAuthMethod.GPAY_PAN for "pan_only" authentication (no cryptogram / PAN-only
flow) or CardAuthMethod.GPAY_DW for 3D Secure (cryptogram-based) authentication.
Routes to ICardProcessingEngine.ProcessAuthAsync (new engine) or
ICardTransactionEngine.ProcessAuth (legacy engine) based on the
NewCardEngineEnabledForMerchantIds SSM feature flag. Custom fields default to an empty
list if null. Results are mapped to {RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletTransactionDetailCard}. Emits
CardAuthEvent and CardTransaction gateway events. Reseller users must provide the
MerchantId header.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The Google Pay digital wallet request containing the encrypted payment token,
            wallet merchant ID, amount, invoice ID, and custom fields. Must not be null.

post.summary: Process a card sale via Google Pay.
post.description:
Processes a Google Pay card sale (combined authorization and capture). Decrypts the Google Pay
payment token via IDigitalWalletClient.ProcessGooglePayLoadAsync (which calls
IGooglePayCryptography.DecryptGooglePayAsync), then maps the decrypted DPAN, expiry,
cryptogram, and authentication type to a CardSaleRequest. The authentication method is
determined by the AuthenticationType from the decrypted response:
CardAuthMethod.GPAY_PAN for "pan_only" authentication or
CardAuthMethod.GPAY_DW for 3D Secure (cryptogram-based) authentication. Routes to
ICardProcessingEngine.ProcessAuthAsync (new engine, mapping to CardSale) or
ICardTransactionEngine.ProcessAuth with CardTransactionType.Sale (legacy engine,
mapping to CardAuthOld) based on the NewCardEngineEnabledForMerchantIds SSM
feature flag. The transaction is immediately captured for settlement. Results are mapped to
{RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.DigitalWalletTransactionDetailCard}. Emits CardSaleEvent and
CardTransaction gateway events. Reseller users must provide the MerchantId header.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The Google Pay digital wallet request containing the encrypted payment token,
            wallet merchant ID, amount, invoice ID, and custom fields. Must not be null.

get.summary: Get a fraud velocity template by ID.
get.description:
Retrieves a single fraud velocity template by its ID, mapped to the public {RepayGatewayApi.Models.Request.FraudVelocityTemplate} response model
containing ID, name, active status, timezone, card/ACH/disbursement settings, custom messages, and merchant keys.

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the template to retrieve.

delete.summary: Delete a fraud velocity template by ID.
delete.description:
Deletes a fraud velocity template by its ID. Active templates cannot be deleted and will return HTTP 400.
On removal, the template is deleted from DynamoDB and all associated merchant XML profiles have their
velocity limit settings disabled and template references cleared.

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the template to delete.

put.description:
Activates a fraud velocity template, propagating its velocity limit settings (card, ACH, disbursement
tracking and notification flags) to all associated merchant XML profiles. If the template is already
active, returns HTTP 200 without changes.

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the template to activate.

put.description:
Deactivates a fraud velocity template, disabling its velocity limit settings on all associated merchant
XML profiles. If the template is already inactive, returns HTTP 200 without changes.

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the template to deactivate.

put.summary: Add merchants to a fraud velocity template.
put.description:
Adds merchants to a fraud velocity template by appending the specified merchant keys to the template's
merchant metadata list. The updated template is persisted to DynamoDB and merchant XML profiles are updated.

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the template to add merchants to.

parameters.name: merchant_keys
parameters.description: List of merchant keys (IDs) to add to the template.

put.summary: Remove merchants from a fraud velocity template.
put.description:
Removes merchants from a fraud velocity template by removing the specified merchant keys from the template's
merchant metadata list. The updated template is persisted to DynamoDB and merchant XML profiles are updated.

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the template to remove merchants from.

parameters.name: merchant_keys
parameters.description: List of merchant keys (IDs) to remove from the template.

post.summary: Create a new fraud velocity template.
post.description:
Creates a new fraud velocity template. If an ID is provided and a template with that ID already exists,
returns HTTP 409 (Conflict). The template is persisted to DynamoDB and associated merchant XML profiles
are updated with the template's velocity limit configuration.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The fraud velocity template containing ID (optional), name, active status, timezone,
            card/ACH/disbursement velocity settings, custom messages, and merchant key assignments.

patch.summary: Partially update a fraud velocity template.
patch.description:
Partially updates an existing fraud velocity template by merging the provided fields into the existing template.
Only non-null/non-empty fields in the request overwrite the corresponding fields on the existing template.
Mergeable fields include name, active status, merchant keys, timezone, and card/ACH/disbursement velocity settings.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The fraud velocity template with the fields to update. The Id field is required.

post.summary: Check card eligibility for Visa Direct funds transfer.
post.description:
Verifies whether a card is eligible for Visa Direct funds transfer (disbursement). Builds a
{RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.FundsTransferInquiry} from the authenticated merchant's context:
<list type="bullet"><item><description>MerchantKey — from IRequestInfo.Merchant.MerchantId</description></item><item><description>CardNumber — from request.PrimaryAccountNumber</description></item><item><description>IsTestMerchant — from IRequestInfo.Merchant.IsTestMerchant (routes to certification or production Visa FTI client)</description></item><item><description>CountryCode — from IRequestInfo.Merchant.Address.CountryCode (defaults to {RepayGatewayApi.Common.Enums.CountryCode.USA})</description></item></list>
Delegates to IFundsTransferInquiryEngine.VerifyFundsTransferEligibilityAsync with
validateCardBrand: true, which performs BIN data lookup, intelligent processor routing,
card brand validation against the processor profile's supported card types, and a Visa Funds
Transfer Inquiry API call. The Visa FTI response is evaluated by
IFundsTransferEligibilityChecker.GetEligibility to determine the final eligibility.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The funds transfer inquiry request containing the required
            PrimaryAccountNumber (13–19 characters).

get.summary: Basic liveness health check.
get.description:
Basic liveness health check endpoint. Returns HTTP 200 with no body to indicate the API
process is running and responsive. Does not verify database, DynamoDB, or processor
connectivity. Visible in Swagger API documentation.

get.summary: Get eCash merchant details by organization ID.
get.description:
Retrieves eCash settlement service merchant details by organization ID.
Returns the merchant's configuration as a key-value dictionary including organization info,
account details, portfolio settings, and billing information.

parameters.name: org_id
parameters.description: The REPAY organization identifier (GUID) assigned to the merchant.

get.summary: List TSYS net settlement merchants by criteria.
get.description:
Retrieves a list of TSYS net settlement merchants matching the criteria provided in the
request body. The request key-value pairs are transformed into a list-merchants Lambda
request containing one or more gateway MIDs and/or RCS MIDs. Returns the matching merchants
as a key-value dictionary. Restricted to reseller users with security level 5 or higher.

get.summary: Get all originating applications from the EIN Manager.
get.description:
Retrieves all originating applications registered in the EIN Manager system.
Used by the merchant onboarding UI to populate the list of available systems (e.g., "tsys-net-settlement").
Restricted to reseller users with security level 5 or higher.

post.summary: Query organization details by operating unit IDs.
post.description:
Queries the EIN Manager for organization details by operating unit IDs and originating application.
Resolves each operating unit ID to an EIN via the EIN Manager lender endpoint, then retrieves
the lender's applications and operating units. For TSYS net settlement, also expands TSYS MIDs.
Returns the application name, organization ID, and organization name for each match.
Restricted to reseller users with security level 5 or higher.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The query request containing a list of operating unit IDs and the originating application name.

post.summary: Create an eCash merchant for an organization.
post.description:
Creates a new merchant in the eCash settlement service for the specified organization ID.
The request body contains merchant configuration as key-value pairs that are transformed into
the eCash create merchant JSON request format. An audit trail entry is recorded on success.
Restricted to reseller users with security level 5 or higher.

parameters.name: org_id
parameters.description: The REPAY organization identifier (GUID) for the new merchant.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Dictionary of merchant configuration key-value pairs.

post.summary: Update an eCash merchant for an organization.
post.description:
Updates an existing merchant in the eCash settlement service for the specified organization ID.
The request body contains updated merchant configuration as key-value pairs that are transformed into
the eCash update merchant JSON request format. Only the supplied values are updated.
An audit trail entry is recorded on success. Restricted to reseller users with security level 5 or higher.

parameters.name: org_id
parameters.description: The REPAY organization identifier (GUID) of the merchant to update.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Dictionary of merchant configuration key-value pairs to update.

post.summary: Get a TSYS net settlement merchant by criteria.
post.description:
Retrieves a single TSYS net settlement merchant matching the criteria provided in the
request body. The request key-value pairs are transformed into a get-merchant Lambda
request containing gateway MID and/or RCS MID identifiers. Returns the merchant
configuration as a key-value dictionary. Restricted to reseller users with security
level 5 or higher.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Dictionary of query criteria key-value pairs (e.g., gateway MID, RCS MID).

post.summary: Create or update a TSYS net settlement merchant.
post.description:
Creates or updates a merchant in the TSYS net settlement service. The request body contains
merchant configuration as key-value pairs that are transformed into the net settlement
create/update request format, including SouthState FBO/RPY account and routing numbers from
configuration. Invokes the net settlement Lambda function. An audit trail entry is recorded
on success. Restricted to reseller users with security level 5 or higher.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Dictionary of merchant configuration key-value pairs.

post.summary: Query card transactions for auto-reconciliation.
post.description:
Purpose-built, lightweight reconciliation query (RG-30150) across all merchants, for the reseller
reconciliation consumer. Returns a flat projection of the fields the reconciliation consumer needs
(transaction id, host reference number, card BIN, last four, total amount, transaction type, result),
with none of the custom-field, ITR-retry, external-identifier, associated-transaction, column-masking,
or paging machinery of the general card query. Backed by a single-SELECT stored procedure with a
bounded command timeout.
When ReconciliationQueryDisbursementFeesEnabled is on, batch-funded Disbursement transactions on
instant-funding fee-enabled merchants are also enriched with the disbursement service fee breakdown
(disbursement_service_fee, repay_disbursement_service_fee, merchant_disbursement_service_fee,
disbursed_amount), and total_amount reflects the gross disbursement amount (net + fee) rather than the
net amount stored on the transaction. With the flag off the fee fields are omitted and total_amount is
unchanged, so the API can deploy ahead of the reconciliation consumer.
Enforces the same data-retention policy limits on the query date range as the general reseller card
query, returning HTTP 400 for an out-of-range window rather than letting an oversized scan hit the
command timeout.
Supports an optional comma-delimited transaction-type filter, an optional host-reference-number
requirement, and an optional result filter ("All", "Approvals", "Declines"; defaults to "All").

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
Reconciliation query parameters: required date range, optional transaction-type CSV,
            optional host-reference-number requirement, and optional result filter.

post.summary: Query settled disbursement transactions for reseller-level reporting.
post.description:
Queries settled disbursement transactions for reseller-level reporting, including associated
DisbursementFunding and DisbFdgReversal transaction details. Only returns Disbursement-type
transactions that have been settled. Enforces data retention policy limits on the query date range.
Status fields are formatted as "ResultCode: Description" (e.g., "0: Approved", "12: Declined").
Supports filtering by currency, funding type ("All", "Batch", "RealTime"), transaction status
("Approvals", "Declines", "All"), and optional merchant ID prefix.
Returns results in JSON, CSV, or Excel format.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
Query parameters including required date range and currency, with optional funding type,
            transaction status, and merchant ID prefix filters.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format: "csv" or "excel" for file export, or null/omit for JSON.

post.summary: Query card transactions for reseller-level reporting (deprecated).
post.description:
Deprecated (RG-30150): the auto-reconciliation consumer should use
POST card/reconciliation-query, a purpose-built lightweight query. This endpoint runs the
full generic reporting machinery (custom fields, ITR retries, associated transactions,
column masking, HATEOAS, paging) and can time out for reconciliation-scale ranges.
Removal is tracked by RG-30880; the endpoint remains functional until then.
Queries card transactions for reseller-level reporting across all merchants.
Enforces data retention policy limits on the query date range. Results are subject to
user-based column access restriction rules that may hide sensitive fields based on the
authorized user's group membership.
Returns results in JSON (with HATEOAS links), CSV, Excel, or PDF format.
If the model state is invalid, returns an empty transaction list.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The card transaction query parameters including date range, merchant filters, transaction ID, and other criteria.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version for HATEOAS link generation.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format: "csv" or "excel" for file export, "pdf" for PDF, or null/omit for JSON.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Number of records to return for pagination.

post.summary: Query Fiserv regional-network transaction detail for reseller-level regional reporting.
post.description:
Purpose-built query across all merchants. Returns a flat 15-field regional
transaction detail projection (Processing MID, Sponsor Name, Acquiring BIN,
Acquiring Institution ID Code, etc.). Enforces the same data-retention policy limits as
the other card endpoints on this controller, and supports paging via {skip}
and {take}.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Query parameters: required processing-date range.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Number of records to return for pagination.

get.summary: Get all request rules for the authenticated merchant.
get.description:
Retrieves all request rules (pre-transaction routing rules) for the authenticated user's
merchant. Queries ITR_Rules_T where MerchantKey matches and
ResponseRule = false (both active and inactive), maps each record to a
{RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.TransRoutingRule} containing the rule ID, description, RuleConfig
(conditions and actions), merchant key, priority, and active status. Returns only the
RequestRules portion of the routing configuration. Restricted to authenticated users
with reseller-authorized merchant access.

post.summary: Create a new request rule for the authenticated merchant.
post.description:
Creates a new request rule (pre-transaction routing rule) for the authenticated user's merchant.
Validates the rule configuration: checks that all condition names are recognized (e.g.,
CardType, CardBrand, ConvenienceAmount), validates condition values
against ITR_Card_Type_T for card type/brand conditions, and validates action
ProcessorProfiles exist via IProcessorProfileQueries. Creates the
ITR_Rules_T record with ResponseRule = false, sets MerchantKey and
LastUpdateUserKey, saves to database, then records an audit trail entry of type
ITRRulesInserted with a snapshot of the new rule and the complete list of all request
rules at that point. Restricted to authenticated users with reseller-authorized merchant access.

parameters.name: request_rule
parameters.description:
The rule creation request containing Description,
            RuleConfig (conditions and actions), Priority, and Active (default
            true). Cannot be null.

get.summary: Get all response rules for the authenticated merchant.
get.description:
Retrieves all response rules (post-transaction routing rules) for the authenticated user's
merchant. Queries ITR_Rules_T where MerchantKey matches and
ResponseRule = true (both active and inactive), maps each record to a
{RepayGatewayApi.Models.Models.TransRoutingRule} containing the rule ID, description, RuleConfig
(conditions and actions), merchant key, priority, and active status. Returns only the
ResponseRules portion of the routing configuration. Restricted to authenticated users
with reseller-authorized merchant access.

post.summary: Create a new response rule for the authenticated merchant.
post.description:
Creates a new response rule (post-transaction routing rule) for the authenticated user's
merchant. Performs the same validation as request rule creation — checks condition names,
validates card type/brand conditions against ITR_Card_Type_T, and validates action
ProcessorProfiles via IProcessorProfileQueries. Creates the ITR_Rules_T
record with ResponseRule = true, sets MerchantKey and LastUpdateUserKey,
saves to database, then records an audit trail entry of type ITRRulesInserted with a
snapshot of the new rule and the complete list of all response rules at that point. Restricted
to authenticated users with reseller-authorized merchant access.

parameters.name: response_rule
parameters.description:
The rule creation request containing Description,
            RuleConfig (conditions and actions), Priority, and Active (default
            true).

get.summary: Get supported card types for ITR rule conditions.
get.description:
Retrieves the supported card types for ITR rule conditions. Queries all active
ITR_Card_Type_T records (where IsActive = true) and groups them into a
dictionary keyed by Brand (e.g., "VISA", "MASTERCARD") with values
being lists of Type strings (e.g., "CREDIT", "DEBIT"). These brand/type
combinations are the valid values for CardBrand and CardType conditions in ITR
rule configurations. Restricted to authenticated reseller users.

get.summary: Get ITR rule change audit trail history.
get.description:
Retrieves the audit trail history for ITR rule changes on the authenticated user's merchant.
Queries Audit_Trail_T records where the audit trail type is one of
ITRRulesInserted, ITRRulesUpdated, ITRRulesDeleted, or
ITRRulesRolledBack, filtered by the merchant key and optionally by
{userKey} and/or date range ({startDate} to
{endDate}). Each ITRRulesHistoryResponse contains the audit key
(GUID), user key, username (resolved from User_T), change type, timestamp, and
before/after rule snapshots (From/To) plus the complete list of all rules
at that point (CopyList). Restricted to authenticated users with reseller-authorized
merchant access.
