put.summary: Rollback an ITR rule to a previous audit trail snapshot state.
put.description:
Rolls back an ITR rule to the state captured in a previous audit trail entry. Loads the
Audit_Trail_T record by {auditKey} (GUID) for the authenticated
merchant; throws ItemNotFoundException if not found. Deserializes the audit snapshot
to determine the rule to rollback and the target state:
<list type="bullet"><item><description>If StateAfterChanges = true, rolls back to the To (after)
snapshot state.</description></item><item><description>If StateAfterChanges = false (default), rolls back to the
From (before) snapshot state.</description></item></list>
Determines the rule key from the snapshot's To or From entry, looks up the
current ITR_Rules_T record (if it still exists), and performs the rollback:
if the target snapshot is null and the rule exists, the rule is deleted; if the target snapshot
exists and the rule doesn't, a new rule is created; otherwise, the existing rule's fields are
restored from the snapshot. Takes before/after audit snapshots and records an audit trail entry
of type ITRRulesRolledBack. Restricted to authenticated users with reseller-authorized
merchant access.

parameters.name: audit_key
parameters.description:
The GUID of the Audit_Trail_T record to use as the rollback
            source.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description:
The rollback request containing StateAfterChanges (default
            false) indicating whether to restore the From (before) or To (after)
            snapshot state.

AchAccountValidateRequest.description: Represents a request to validate an ACH account, including account, transit, customer, invoice, and validation options.

account_number.description:
Gets or sets the account number to be validated. The account number.

Constraint: Required if ach_token is not provided.

transit_number.description:
Gets or sets the transit (routing) number to be validated. The transit/routing number.

The value must be either 9 digits for FED US routing numbers or 8-9 for Canadian.

Constraint: Required if ach_token is not provided.

ach_token.description:
Gets or sets the ACH token identifier. An ACH token can be provided as either a numeric or as a string. The ACH token identifier. 

Constraint: Required if account_number and transit_number are not provided.

include_token_name_validation.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether to include token name validation in the ACH account validation process.
If true, the name stored on the token will be used for validation, even if account_holder_details names are provided.
If false or not supplied, account_holder_details names will be used for validation if provided; otherwise no name validation is performed. Indicates if the caller wants the service to use the name stored against the ach_token for validation.

When true, the token name is used even if account_holder_details names are provided.

When false or not supplied, account_holder_details names are used if provided; otherwise no name validation is performed.

Field is only relevant when the ach_token field is provided.

customer_id.description: Gets or sets the customer identifier associated with the validation request. The customer loan number

invoice_id.description: Gets or sets the invoice identifier associated with the validation request. The integrators system of record reference number for the payment/transaction

client_reference_id.description:
Gets or sets the client reference identifier for the validation request. A unique client/integrator defined low level record identifier used to identify the transaction, typically from the Merchants system of record.

Both invoice_id and client_reference_id id can be set, or one of them or neither if integrator doesn't need their own identifier linked to this REPAY request.

This value is not interpreted by the API, it is stored and returned as provided, on the response

account_holder_details.description: Gets or sets the details of the ACH account holder. The Accountholder’s details

force_external_validation.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether to force validation against the external system. In a scenario where name validation is not being performed this field gives the integrator the ability to force the service to perform validation with the third-party provider (MicroBilt), even if an internal REPAY transaction history exists for the account.

If omitted or false, the service will use internal history first and only use the external provider if needed based on the history

skip_internal_transit_number_validation.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to skip internal transit number validation (Fed directory checking). Indicates whether to force the service to skip/bypass the internal transit number validation against REPAY’s own Fed ACH Directory

is_ach_account_ofac_validation_enabled.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether ACH account OFAC validation is enabled for this request.

AchAccountHolderDetails.description: Represents the details of an ACH account holder, including name, date of birth, and address information for validation purposes.

first_name.description:
Gets or sets the account holder's first name. When provided, this will result in the API making a call to the third-party provider (MicroBilt) to validate the account and the name. Can be provided on its own without the last name if needed. The Accountholder’s first name. When provided this will result in the API making a call to the third-party provider (MicroBilt) to validate the account and the name.

Can be provided on its own without the last_name if needed

last_name.description:
Gets or sets the account holder's last name. When provided, this will result in the API making a call to the third-party provider (MicroBilt) to validate the account and the name. Can be provided on its own without the first name if needed. The Accountholder’s last name. When provided this will result in the API making a call to the third-party provider (MicroBilt) to validate the account and the name.

Can be provided on its own without the first_name if needed

date_of_birth.description: Gets or sets the account holder's date of birth in yyyy-MM-dd format.

address.description: Gets or sets the address information for the account holder.

AchAccountHolderAddress.description: Represents the address information for an ACH account holder, including street, city, state, and ZIP code.

street.description: Gets or sets the street address of the account holder (maximum 64 characters).

city.description: Gets or sets the city of the account holder (maximum 64 characters).

state.description: Gets or sets the state of the account holder (2 characters).

zip.description: Gets or sets the ZIP code of the account holder (maximum 10 characters).

AchAccountValidationResponse.description: Represents the response for an ACH account validation, including decision, provider, status, and additional validation details.

decision.description:
Gets or sets the decision for the account validation. ACCEPT if valid, DECLINE if not valid. Indicates whether there is a negative or positive history recorded for the account, with the decision provider value noted below.

The value will be one of the following:

ACCEPT - No negative history is recorded with the decision provider for the account

DECLINE - A negative history is recorded with the decision provider for the account

provider.description:
Gets or sets the provider of the validation data. REPAY for internal, EXTERNAL for external system. The provider who is providing the account validation decision.

The value will be one of the following:

REPAY - If the decision value being returned is determined by the REPAY internal history for the account.

EXTERNAL - If the decision value being returned was determined by the third party external validation provider (MicroBilt)

internal_status.description:
Gets or sets the result of internal validation. NO_HIT, HIT_OK, or HIT_NEG. An attempt is always made to validate the account internally against REPAY’s history for the account, and this field’s value reflects the result of that internal validation.

The value will be one of the following:

NO_HIT - The account was unknown to REPAY

HIT_OK - The account was known to REPAY, with a positive transaction history

HIT_NEG - The account was known to REPAY, with a negative transaction history

external_status.description:
If required, or if requested, validation with an external provider will be attempted, and external_status reflects the results of that external validation.
UNAVAILABLE - An external account validation provider was unavailable.
HIT_OK - The account was known to an external provider, with a negative transaction history.

external_message.description: Gets or sets the message from the external provider with additional context. Null if not performed. If validation with the third-party external validation provider was attempted, any message returned by that third-party external provider will be included on this field

additional_information.description: Gets or sets additional information from the external system. Null if only internal validation was performed. If present, this can include additional information about the Account which was received during a validation, grouped under different objects

name_validation_performed.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether name validation was performed. This field indicates if Name Validation was successfully performed.

If present and the value is true then this is a billable event for the Merchant.

If present and the value is false then this is not a billable event for the Merchant and the reason why its set to false can be seen in the name_validation_performed_text field

name_validation_performed_text.description:
Gets or sets the text describing if name validation was performed. If present, this field contains descriptive text for the name_validation_performed field value.

If the name_validation_performed field is set to true, this field will have a value of "Name Validation was performed, and is a billable event.".

If the name_validation_performed field is set to false, this field will have a value of one of the following:

"Some accounts are not available for Name Validation due to Issuer or 3rd party constraints. You are receiving this as Name Validation for this account is not available at this time."

"ACH Account Name Validation is not enabled. Please contact your REPAY representative if you want this additional validation feature enabled for you."

"ACH Account Name Validation is enabled, provide account_holder_details.first_name or account_holder_details.last_name fields on the request to perform."

name_validation_result.description:
Gets or sets the result of the name validation. If the name_validation_performed field is present and has a value of true, this field will be present and it will indicate the overall result of the name validation that was performed.

The value will be one of the following:

0 - This value means Match

1 - This value means Partial Match

2 - This value means No Match

name_validation_result_text.description:
Gets or sets the text describing the name validation result. This field contains descriptive text for the name_validation_result field value.

The value will be one of the following:

Match

Partial Match

No Match

name_validation_result_details.description: Gets or sets the details of the name validation result. This field contains child fields that have further details about the name validation matching that was performed

previous_name_on_token.description: Gets or sets the name that was previously stored against the ACH token before being updated with newly validated account holder names. If present, this field contains the name that was stored against the ACH token before it was updated with the newly validated accountholder names provided on the request.

previous_name_on_token_text.description: Gets or sets descriptive text for the previous name on token field. If previous_name_on_token is present, this field contains descriptive text indicating that the service has updated the name stored against the ACH token.

ofac_validation_performed.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether OFAC validation was performed for the account. This field indicates if OFAC Validation was successfully performed.

If present and the the value is true then this is a billable event for the Merchant.

If present and the value is false then this is not a billable event for the Merchant and the reason why its set to false can be seen in the ofac_validation_performed_text field.

ofac_validation_performed_text.description:
Gets or sets the text describing if OFAC validation was performed. If present, this field contains descriptive text for the ofac_validation_performed field value.

If the ofac_validation_performed field is set to true, this field will have a value of "OFAC Validation was performed, and is a billable event.".

If the ofac_validation_performed field is set to false, this field will have a value of one of the following:

"OFAC Validation could not be performed at this time due to Issuer or 3rd party constraints. You are receiving this as OFAC Validation is not available at this time."

"OFAC Validation is not enabled. Please contact your REPAY representative if you want this additional validation feature enabled for you."

"OFAC Validation is enabled, provide at least the account_holder_details.address.street, account_holder_details.first_name and account_holder_details.last_name fields on the request to perform."

ofac_validation_result.description:
Gets or sets the result of the OFAC validation. If the ofac_validation_performed field is present and has a value of true, this field will be present and it will indicate the overall result of the OFAC validation that was performed.

The value will be one of the following:

0 - This value means Possible Match

1 - This value means No Match

ofac_validation_result_text.description:
Gets or sets the text describing the OFAC validation result. This field contains descriptive text for the ofac_validation_result field value.

The value will be one of the following:

Possible Match

No Match

ofac_validation_result_details.description: Gets or sets the details of the OFAC validation result. This field contains child fields that have further details about the OFAC validation matching that was performed

customer_id.description: Gets or sets the customer identifier associated with the validation, if available. The customer loan number, if provided on the request

invoice_id.description: Gets or sets the invoice identifier associated with the validation, if available. The integrators system of record reference number for the payment/transaction, if provided on the request

client_reference_id.description: Gets or sets the client reference identifier associated with the validation, if available. A unique client/integrator defined low level record identifier used to identify the transaction, typically from the Merchants system of record, if provided on the request

host_reference_id.description:
Gets or sets the host reference identifier associated with the validation, if available. A value assigned by the third-party external provider to uniquely identify the validation if the external provider was used for the validation.

This value does not have a strict format and is a free text based reference.

This can be used in communications between REPAY and the third-party external provider if there are any concerns/issues to raise for the validation request

reference_id.description:
Gets or sets the unique identifier for the API request, used for traceability and troubleshooting. A value assigned by REPAY to uniquely identify the request received and response sent.

This value does not have a strict format and is a free text based reference.

This can be used in communications within REPAY if there are any concerns/issues to raise for the validation request

CardAccountValidateResponse.description: Represents the response for card account validation, including result, approval, card details, name validation, and error information.

result.description:
Gets or sets the result code of the card account validation. The result of the validation of the Card Account.

The value will be one of the following:

0 - This value means the account was successfully validated and the resulting decision was that the Account is valid

12 - This value can mean two things:

The account was successfully validated and the resulting decision was that the Account is Invalid

The account was not successfully validated due to an issue calling the processor to validate the Account, when this is the case the approval_code field will contain a 106 code value

result_text.description:
Gets or sets the result text describing the validation outcome. The descriptive text for the result field value.

The value will be one of the following:

Account Valid

Account Invalid

Account Validation currently unavailable. Please contact REPAY Support for further assistance

approval_code.description:
Gets or sets the approval code for the card transaction. The approval code. This field can be used to return different values

The action code from the processor after a card account validation which resulted in a decision of the card account being either valid or invalid

A 106 code value provided by REPAY to indicate that the processor was unable to be called successfully for the card account validation

card_bin.description:
Gets or sets the BIN (Bank Identification Number) of the card. The card BIN (Bank Identification Number) for the card provided on the request.

It is the first 4 to 6 digits of a payment card that identify the issuing financial institution

last4.description: Gets or sets the last four digits of the card number. The last four digits of the card provided on the request

exp_date.description: Gets or sets the expiration date of the card (MMYY). The expiration date of the card, if provided on the exp_date field on the request

card_info.description: Gets or sets additional card information. Additional Card information retrieved during processing of the request

date.description: Gets or sets the date and time of the validation response. If present, can contain one or more of the listed sub fields related to metrics on the account

name_validation_performed.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether name validation was performed. This field indicates if Name Validation was successfully performed.

If the value is true then this is a billable event for the Merchant.

If the value is false then this is not a billable event for the Merchant and the reason why its set to false can be seen in the name_validation_performed_text field

name_validation_performed_text.description:
Gets or sets the text describing if name validation was performed. This field contains descriptive text for the name_validation_performed field value.

When the name_validation_performed field is set to true, this field will have a value of "Name Validation was performed, and is a billable event.".

When the name_validation_performed field is set to false, this field will have a value of one of the following:

"Some accounts are not available for Name Validation due to Issuer or 3rd party constraints. You are receiving this as Name Validation for this account is not available at this time."

"Card Account Name Validation is not enabled. Please contact your REPAY representative if you want this additional validation feature enabled for you."

"Card Account Name Validation is enabled, provide at least the account_holder_details.last_name field on the request to perform."

name_validation_result.description:
Gets or sets the result of the name validation. If the name_validation_performed field is present and has a value of true, this field will be present and it will indicate the overall result of the name validation that was performed.

The value will be one of the following:

0 - This value means Match

1 - This value means Partial Match

2 - This value means No Match

name_validation_result_text.description:
Gets or sets the text describing the name validation result. This field contains descriptive text for the name_validation_result field value.

The value will be one of the following:

Match

Partial Match

No Match

name_validation_result_details.description: Gets or sets the details of the name validation result. This field contains child fields that have further details about the name validation matching that was performed

previous_name_on_token.description:
Gets or sets the previous name on the token, if token name validation was performed. If present, this field contains the name that was stored against the card token before it was updated with the newly validated accountholder names provided on the request.

The name stored against the card token will only be updated in the event that the accountholder names provided on the request result in a Partial Match or Match name validation result.

Request for the purpose-built reconciliation card query (RG-30150). Kept intentionally general
(parameterized transaction types and result filter) so it can reconcile more than disbursements

(e.g. "Disbursement,DisbursementFunding,DisbFdgReversal"). When omitted, no type filter is applied.

Gets or sets a value indicating whether to return only transactions that reached the downstream
host (a non-empty host reference number). Defaults to false. An empty host reference number means
the transaction was recorded in the Gateway but has no corresponding transaction at the host it
was sent to; it is not a card-brand indicator.

result_filter.description:
